instruction:
Courtyard Starter House Zone Schedule

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad one-storey courtyard starter house model and save the required outputs to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities and at least 1 IfcRoof entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: ENTRY, LIVING-DINING, KITCHEN, BED-1, BED-2, BATH, LAUNDRY, and COURTYARD.
7. Each listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey.
8. Each listed space has a Reference property or LongName equal to its zone number: ENTRY Z01, LIVING-DINING Z02, KITCHEN Z03, BED-1 Z04, BED-2 Z05, BATH Z06, LAUNDRY Z07, and COURTYARD Z08.
9. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are ENTRY 9.0 m2, LIVING-DINING 24.0 m2, KITCHEN 9.0 m2, BED-1 12.0 m2, BED-2 12.0 m2, BATH 4.0 m2, LAUNDRY 3.0 m2, and COURTYARD 18.0 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
10. The COURTYARD area is between 14.0 m2 and 24.0 m2.
11. Each BED-1 and BED-2 area is between 8.0 m2 and 16.0 m2.
12. The sum of ENTRY, LIVING-DINING, KITCHEN, BED-1, BED-2, BATH, and LAUNDRY areas is between 65.0 m2 and 110.0 m2.
13. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area.
14. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 8 data rows in the same zone order and with the same zone numbers, names, and areas listed in the IFC pass conditions.
15. Each schedule Area value matches the corresponding IFC space area with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
